legacy_semantic_golden_reference.conclusion: the golden simulation marked direct PG16/PG18 transaction-boundary proof as a remaining gate

jdbc_test_reference.conclusion: both container tests require 42703, then 25P02, then successful read after rollback

transaction_failure_boundary.conclusion: catching an optional statistics statement inside one PostgreSQL transaction does not make later statements usable; rollback or an independent clean transaction boundary is required
